name: Review Showcase for TikTok
author: Maidul

sections.description:
Review Showcase for TikTok is a powerful TikTok reviews WordPress plugin designed to display TikTok video testimonials and reviews in a fast-loading, SEO-friendly, and responsive layout. Easily embed TikTok videos or video feeds using public URLs or hashtags, and showcase your social proof with attractive, mobile-optimized grids or carousels. This plugin is ideal for businesses and influencers looking to leverage TikTok carousel displays to build trust and boost conversions on their WordPress sites.

With built-in support for star ratings and customizable call-to-action buttons, Review Showcase for TikTok helps you create engaging testimonial sections that enhance user experience and improve SEO. The plugin uses lightweight, performance-optimized code and integrates Swiper.js for smooth, touch-enabled navigation on all devices.

Key Features

  • TikTok video feeds and testimonials using public URLs or hashtags
  • SEO‑friendly responsive design for better search rankings
  • Lightweight, performance‑optimized code with caching for fast loading
  • Optional star ratings and customizable CTA buttons for enhanced engagement
  • Mobile‑friendly Swiper.js integration for smooth carousel navigation
  • Shortcode and Gutenberg block support for flexible placement

Shortcode Attributes

Use the [tiktok_review_showcase] shortcode with optional attributes to customize the display of TikTok video testimonials:

  • ids — Comma-separated list of specific review post IDs to display. Example: ids="1,2,3"
  • limit — Number of reviews to show if ids is not specified. Default: 6
  • orderby — Field to sort reviews by. Options include date, title, etc. Default: date
  • order — Sort order, either ASC or DESC. Default: DESC
  • tag — Filter reviews by the review_tag taxonomy. Example: tag="happy-customers"
  • class — Add custom CSS classes to the wrapper element for styling
  • layout — Choose layout style: carousel (default) or grid
  • show_rating — Display star ratings: true (default) or false
  • show_cta — Show call-to-action button: true (default) or false

Example Usage

[tiktok_review_showcase layout="grid" limit="6" show_rating="true" show_cta="false"]<h3>External Services</h3>

This plugin connects to the following external services:

  • TikTok — for embedding publicly available video content via https://www.tiktok.com/embed.js.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data from users directly.

However, embedded TikTok videos may collect usage data as per TikTok’s own privacy policy. Please review their privacy policy for more information.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Video Reviews in your WordPress dashboard to add new TikTok video testimonials.
  4. Use the shortcode [tiktok_review_showcase] or the Gutenberg block to display TikTok video reviews on your site.
sections.faq:
Can I use videos from platforms other than TikTok?

Currently, this plugin supports embedding TikTok video testimonials and reviews using public TikTok URLs or hashtags. Support for additional platforms may be introduced in future updates to expand your social proof options.

Can I customize the call-to-action buttons?

Yes, you can easily customize the CTA buttons by specifying the label and URL when adding or editing each TikTok video review in the WordPress dashboard, allowing you to tailor calls to action for maximum engagement.

Is this plugin optimized for mobile devices?

Absolutely. Review Showcase for TikTok features a mobile-friendly, SEO-optimized design and integrates Swiper.js for smooth, touch-enabled carousel navigation, ensuring your TikTok video testimonials look great on all screen sizes.
